sources.observed: The saved-code profile specifies at least64 random bits, hashed storage and throttling. It also requires a replacement after use and recovery notifications for replacement/account recovery.
sources.application: FRD17 follows Revision4 guidance. Preserve these technical constraints for the reviewed saved-code profile; refine lifecycle responsibilities across009/011/016. Do not copy issued-contact-code lifetimes, invent automatic side effects, or claim complete NIST conformance.

sources.observed: Default generation uses ten random positions drawn from26 symbols and a fixed separator. Storage receives Distinct(), while the original list is returned.
sources.inference: Maximum default entropy is10*log2(26)=47.004397181410916bits, below the saved-code floor. Default format reuse must remain unselected; built-in framework RNG plus supported encoding and native salted hasher is a narrow candidate, not copied cryptography or an approved production profile. Force-collision testing must prove returned/stored uniqueness.
